caption: The drawing features a single standing object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The main object is a vertical pole with a round, brown base that has visible striped wood grain details. The pole itself is slender and brown, resembling wood, and it extends upward to support a small, dark fixture at the top, from which a short, lighter element and a small, dark cylindrical object hang. At the upper left corner within the drawing, there is an inset diagram rendered in brown and red ink that shows a simplified side view of the same object, including a scale notation and some measurement lines. The composition includes thin rectangular borders in brown ink framing both the main depiction and the inset diagram. The artist’s name and a code (“Samuel Freeman-Del-259-1”) are written in small text at the lower right inside the main rectangular border. The overall color palette is muted, consisting primarily of shades of brown, gray, and off-white.
title: Combination Rush & Candle Stand
